## Visual change

Describe what changed and which sprite IDs or screens are affected.

## Evidence

Add before/after screenshots at local and nation zoom, plus a phone view.

## Validation

- [ ] Gameplay and saved-game semantics unchanged, or separately agreed
- [ ] Source artwork, exports and mappings included
- [ ] Resource visibility and selection remain correct
- [ ] Offline cache updated for new runtime assets
- [ ] Tests/checks listed with any remaining limitations
